subject: CloudMart EDU partner credits - request & issuance plan
messages:
From: Dana Li <dana.li@cloudmart.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: partners@cloudmart.com
Date: Thu, 28 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CloudMart EDU — request for partner-issued trial credits

Hi Camila,

Thanks again for the demo last week — excited about the EDU pilot we talked about. We have a cohort launch on June 10 and want to offer students a low-friction path to try Redwood Inference via partner-issued credits (self-serve vouchers) instead of a manual grant process.

Specifically, can CloudMart get a pool of 500 small vouchers (each redeemable for $25 of usage) that our marketplace can surface at signup? We prefer self-serve voucher codes that users can redeem on sign-up, and ideally a CSV with codes and expiration dates so our ops team can surface them.

I've attached a brief MOA with our expected usage and co-marketing blurb. Happy to sign any partner terms you need. Do you need a legal PO or anything from our side to kick this off? We can be flexible but would love to get this live before June 10.

Thanks — feel free to pull in whoever owns partner credits on your side.

Dana Li
Partnerships Lead, CloudMart
partners@cloudmart.com

Attachment: MOA_cloudmart_partner_credit_terms.pdf

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 28 May 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CloudMart EDU — request for partner-issued trial credits

Thanks Dana — this is doable and congrats on the EDU launch. I'm looping in Partner Ops (Marissa) and Marketplace Sales (Nikhil) so we can get the right fulfillment path.

Quick plan I propose:
- We can support a marketplace-voucher flow (codes you surface at signup) OR Redwood-generated promo codes you distribute.
- To keep things self-serve we should go with Redwood promo codes delivered as a CSV that CloudMart uploads into your marketplace. That avoids per-user manual grants.
- Need: signed MOA (thanks for attaching), confirmed total pool size (you asked for 500 x $25 = $12,500 total), and preferred expiry (suggest 90 days).

Marissa / Nikhil — can one of you confirm standard ops steps and timeline? If we need a billing exception or pre-funded allocation, I will loop in Ben for approval.

Dana — cc'ing mp-ops@cloudmart.com in case they have a preferred format for the CSV.

—Camila
Camila Reyes
Senior Partnerships, Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 29 May 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CloudMart EDU — request for partner-issued trial credits

Hi all — thanks for the details. Operational checklist and timeline below: 

1) Terms: we need an executed MOA (attached copy from Dana). Once signed, legal will clear the partner program terms and we can proceed with issuance.
2) Billing/funding: Partner credits can be issued either against a pre-funded promotional bucket or as a billed write-off. For self-serve marketplace vouchers we normally require Promo Pool funding to be recorded in billing.
3) CSV format: we need columns: code, value_usd, expiry_date (YYYY-MM-DD), partner_reference. We can generate codes on our side and deliver as cloudmart_credit_list.csv.
4) Quantity & limits: 500 codes x $25 each = $12,500. We recommend expiry 2026-08-08 (70 days) to align with your cohort — please confirm.
5) Timeline: with a signed MOA and funding approval we can generate codes within 48 business hours and provide the CSV + a lightweight fulfillment playbook for your marketplace.

Attached: example CSV template (cloudmart_credit_list.csv).

If you prefer marketplace-native promo codes (CloudMart-managed), we will provide an invoice for the promo pool and confirm redemption tracking hooks. Both approaches work; self-serve Redwood-generated codes are faster.

Marissa Cole
Partner Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachment: cloudmart_credit_list.csv
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>

Ben — can finance approve a one-time promotional fund or a pre-funded promo pool for this partner? If so, please advise the accounting tag and whether you need a PO/invoice first.

Thanks — Nikhil
